title: EF BB BF starting with UTF-8 is an optional signature
summary: UTF-8 has no endian selection. The starting EF BB BF represents U+FEFF, which can be used as a text signature.
applies: Unicode text and JSON byte records
detail: Some decoders strip off the leading signature, others keep U+FEFF, so displaying the same text may have different first characters or digests.
boundary: The same bytes in the middle of the file should not be unconditionally deleted based on the file's starting signature.
relevance: Explain the situation where the field names in the first column appear to be consistent, but the comparison fails.
